# Tile

```tsx
import { Tile, TileCarousel, tileSurfaceVariants } from "@lucasdost/design-system"
```

A shortcut to an action or a page: an icon and a label on a raised surface. Mirrors the Figma Tile: Size (Small / Medium / Large) × State (Default / Hover / Disabled) + Focus. Renders a `<button>`, or a link through `render`. `TileCarousel` is the Figma Tile Carousel: a row of Tiles between two arrows.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
<Tile
  size={args.size}
  label={args.label}
  icon={findHugeicon(args.icon) ?? CommandIcon}
  disabled={args.disabled}
  onClick={args.onClick}
/>
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Tile: Size (Small / Medium / Large) × State (Default / Hover / Disabled) + Focus.
- The surface is Background/Surface with Shadow/Small, Border/Radius/Medium corners and an Inside Border/Secondary stroke (an inset ring, so it takes no room).
- Hover is Background/Hover, an overlay painted by ::after on top of the surface (like the stacked Figma fills).
- Disabled stacks Background/Disabled/Soft instead, with the Border/Disabled/Soft stroke, no shadow, and the icon and label in Icon/Disabled and Text/Disabled.
- Focus is the 3px Border/Accent/Strong ring, 2px away from the surface.
- The icon is 20px in Icon/Primary.

Parts:
- `Tile`: A shortcut to an action or a page. Renders a `<button>`; pass `render` (an `<a>` or a Next.js `<Link>`) to navigate instead.

## Rules

- Import `Tile` from `@lucasdost/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
